description: This file contains functions for stock balance management, including reposting stock quantities, updating bin data, and handling serial numbers within the ERPNext system.

methods.name: repost
methods.description: Main function to trigger stock reposting for all items and warehouses, optionally allowing negative stock and zero rate adjustments.

methods.name: repost_stock
methods.description: Recalculates stock quantities for a specific item and warehouse, updating actual, reserved, indented, ordered, and planned quantities.

methods.name: repost_actual_qty
methods.description: Creates a stock ledger entry to update the actual stock quantity for an item in a warehouse.

methods.name: get_balance_qty_from_sle
methods.description: Fetches the latest stock quantity after transactions for an item in a warehouse.

methods.name: get_reserved_qty
methods.description: Calculates the reserved quantity of an item in a warehouse based on sales orders and packed items.

methods.name: get_indented_qty
methods.description: Calculates the indented (requested but not yet received) quantity for an item in a warehouse.

methods.name: get_ordered_qty
methods.description: Calculates the total ordered quantity for an item in a warehouse from purchase orders.

methods.name: get_planned_qty
methods.description: Calculates the planned production quantity for an item in a warehouse.

methods.name: update_bin_qty
methods.description: Updates the bin record with new stock quantities and clears cache if changes are made.

methods.name: set_stock_balance_as_per_serial_no
methods.description: Adjusts stock balances for items with serial numbers, creating stock ledger entries accordingly.

methods.name: reset_serial_no_status_and_warehouse
methods.description: Resets the status and warehouse info for serial numbers with pending documents.
